project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite, built as a social media platform (Aurelix)
build_system: Vite 5 with npm as package manager (package-lock.json present). Uses @vitejs/plugin-react-swc for fast compilation.
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, setup in src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm install` to restore dependencies. 2. Run `npm run build` to verify production build succeeds. 3. Run `npm run test` to verify tests pass. 4. Check that capacitor.config.ts exists and is valid. 5. Verify android/ directory is generated with proper structure.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The android/ directory is generated by `npx cap add android` and `npx cap sync`. It should be committed so the project is ready to build an APK.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/parallaxin 2. npm install 3. npm run build (produces dist/) 4. npx cap sync (syncs web assets to android platform)
environment_constraints: Internet access available for npm installs. Node v22.23.2, npm 11.4.2. No Android SDK available on this machine - cannot actually compile the APK, but can set up the Capacitor project structure fully. No Java/Gradle available for native compilation.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Project uses conventional commits based on git log. Main branch is 'main'.
key_patterns: - BrowserRouter from react-router-dom v7 used for routing (in App.tsx) - Lazy loading with React.lazy() for all route components - AuthProvider context wraps entire app - AppShell component provides mobile layout shell - ThemeProvider for dark/light mode - useIsMobile() hook in src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx - HelmetProvider wraps App in main.tsx - Path alias '@' maps to './src'
directory_structure: Root: config files + 32 cleanup python scripts to remove. src/: App.tsx (router), main.tsx (entry), components/ (UI organized by feature), contexts/ (auth, theme, call providers), hooks/ (custom hooks), pages/ (50+ page components), services/, integrations/ (supabase), lib/, types/, utils/. public/: static assets. supabase/: database migrations and config.
